11: # OKX DeFi Invest
12: 
13: Multi-chain DeFi product discovery and investment execution. The CLI handles precision conversion, multi-step orchestration, and validation internally.
14: 
15: For CLI parameter details, see [references/cli-reference.md](references/cli-reference.md).
16: 
17: ## Skill Routing
18: 
19: - For DApp-named investing/lending/staking → use `okx-dapp-discovery`
20: - For DeFi positions / holdings → use `okx-defi-portfolio`
21: - For token price/chart → use `okx-dex-market`
22: - For token search by name/contract → use `okx-dex-token`
23: - For DEX spot swap execution → use `okx-agentic-wallet`
24: - For wallet token balances → use `okx-agentic-wallet`
25: - For broadcasting signed transactions → use `okx-agentic-wallet`
26: - For Agentic Wallet login, balance, contract-call → use `okx-agentic-wallet`
27: 
28: ## Command Index
29: 
30: | # | Command | Description |
31: |---|---------|-------------|
32: | 1 | `defi support-chains` | Get supported chains for DeFi |
33: | 2 | `defi support-platforms` | Get supported platforms for DeFi |
34: | 3 | `defi list` | List top DeFi products by APY |
35: | 4 | `defi search --token <tokens> [--platform <names>] [--chain <chain>] [--product-group <group>]` | Search DeFi products |
36: | 5 | `defi detail --investment-id <id>` | Get full product details |
37: | 6 | `defi invest --investment-id <id> --address <addr> --token <symbol_or_addr> --amount <minimal_units> [--chain <chain>] [--slippage <pct>] [--tick-lower <n>] [--tick-upper <n>] [--token-id <nft>]` | One-step deposit (CLI handles prepare + precision + calldata) |
38: | 7 | `defi withdraw --investment-id <id> --address <addr> --chain <chain> [--ratio <0-1>] [--amount <minimal_units>] [--token-id <nft>] [--platform-id <pid>] [--slippage <pct>]` | One-step withdrawal (CLI handles position lookup + calldata) |
39: | 8 | `defi collect --address <addr> --chain <chain> --reward-type <type> [--investment-id <id>] [--platform-id <pid>] [--token-id <nft>] [--principal-index <idx>]` | One-step reward claim (CLI handles reward check + calldata) |
40: | 9 | `defi positions --address <addr> --chains <chains>` | List DeFi positions by platform |
41: | 10 | `defi position-detail --address <addr> --chain <chain> --platform-id <pid>` | Get detailed position info |
42: | 11 | `defi rate-chart --investment-id <id> [--time-range <range>]` | Historical APY chart data |
43: | 12 | `defi tvl-chart --investment-id <id> [--time-range <range>]` | Historical TVL chart data |
44: | 13 | `defi depth-price-chart --investment-id <id> [--chart-type <type>] [--time-range <range>]` | V3 Pool depth or price history chart |
45: 
46: ## Investment Types
47: 
48: | productGroup | Description |
49: |-------------|-------------|
50: | `SINGLE_EARN` | Single-token yield (savings, staking, vaults) |
51: | `DEX_POOL` | Liquidity pools (Uniswap V2/V3, PancakeSwap, etc.) |
52: | `LENDING` | Lending / borrowing (Aave, Compound, etc.) |
53: 
54: ## Chain Support
55: 
56: CLI resolves chain names automatically (e.g. `ethereum` → `1`, `bsc` → `56`, `solana` → `501`).
57: 
58: ## Operation Flow
59: 
60: ### Step 0: Address Resolution
61: 
62: When the user does NOT provide a wallet address, resolve it automatically from the Agentic Wallet **before** running any defi command:
63: 
64: ```
65: 1. onchainos wallet status          → check if logged in, get active account
66: 2. onchainos wallet addresses       → get addresses grouped by chain category:
67:                                        - XLayer addresses
68:                                        - EVM addresses (Ethereum, BSC, Polygon, etc.)
69:                                        - Solana addresses
70: 3. Match address to target chain:
71:    - EVM chains → use EVM address
72:    - Solana     → use Solana address
73:    - XLayer     → use XLayer address
74: ```
75: 
76: Rules:
77: - If the user provides an explicit address, use it directly — skip this step
78: - If wallet is not logged in, ask the user to log in first (→ `okx-agentic-wallet`) or provide an address manually
79: - If the user says "check all accounts" or "all wallets", use `wallet balance --all` to get all account IDs, then `wallet switch <id>` + `wallet addresses` for each account
80: - Always confirm the resolved address with the user before proceeding if the account has multiple addresses of the same type
81: 
82: ### Deposit (invest)
83: 
84: ```
85: 1. defi search --token USDC --chain ethereum       → pick investmentId
86: 2. defi detail --investment-id <id>                 → confirm APY/TVL, get underlyingToken[].tokenAddress
87: 3. token search --query <tokenAddress> --chains <chain>  → get decimal (e.g. 6) for amount conversion
88: 4. Ask user for amount → convert: userAmount × 10^decimal (e.g. 100 USDC → 100000000)
89: 5. Check wallet balance (okx-agentic-wallet) → if insufficient, warn user and stop
90: 6. defi invest --investment-id <id> --address <addr> --token USDC --amount 100000000
91:    → CLI returns calldata (APPROVE + DEPOSIT steps)
92: 7. User signs and broadcasts each step in order
93: ```
94: 
95: > **Token decimal**: Get `tokenAddress` from `defi detail` → `underlyingToken[].tokenAddress`, then use `token search --query <tokenAddress>` to get `decimal`. Same approach as DEX swap.
96: >
97: > **CRITICAL — Balance check is REQUIRED before calling `defi invest`.** You MUST call `okx-agentic-wallet` to verify the user has sufficient balance of the deposit token BEFORE generating calldata. If balance is insufficient, STOP and warn the user. Do NOT proceed to `defi invest` without confirming balance. Skipping this step wastes gas and results in failed on-chain transactions.
98: 
99: ### Withdraw
100: 
101: > **CRITICAL — position-detail is MANDATORY before withdraw.** You MUST call `defi position-detail` immediately before every `defi withdraw`, even if you already have position data from a previous call. Do NOT reuse stale position-detail results.
102: 
103: ```
104: 1. defi positions --address <addr> --chains ethereum
105: 2. defi position-detail --address <addr> --chain ethereum --platform-id <pid>
106:    → MUST be called fresh — get investmentId, tokenPrecision, coinAmount (current balance)
107: 3. Full exit:
108:    defi withdraw --investment-id <id> --address <addr> --chain ethereum --ratio 1 --platform-id <pid>
109:    Partial exit (convert coinAmount to minimal units: amount × 10^tokenPrecision):
110:    defi withdraw --investment-id <id> --address <addr> --chain ethereum --amount <minimal_units> --platform-id <pid>
111: 4. User signs and broadcasts
112: ```
113: 
114: > **Partial exit --amount**: position-detail returns `coinAmount` in human-readable (e.g. "2.3792") and `tokenPrecision` (e.g. 6). Convert to minimal units: `floor(2.3792 × 10^6) = 2379200` → `--amount 2379200`.
115: 
116: ### Claim Rewards
117: 
118: > **CRITICAL — position-detail is MANDATORY before collect.** You MUST call `defi position-detail` immediately before every `defi collect`, even if you already have position data from a previous call in the conversation. Position data (rewards, investmentId, platformId, tokenId) changes after each on-chain operation (withdraw, previous collect, etc.), so stale data leads to wrong parameters or failed transactions. Do NOT skip this step. Do NOT reuse position-detail results from earlier in the conversation.
119: 
120: ```
121: 1. defi positions --address <addr> --chains ethereum
122: 2. defi position-detail --address <addr> --chain ethereum --platform-id <pid>
123:    → MUST be called fresh — do NOT reuse prior results
124: 3. defi collect --address <addr> --chain ethereum --reward-type REWARD_INVESTMENT --investment-id <id> --platform-id <pid>
125:    → CLI returns calldata (or skips if no rewards)
126: 4. User signs and broadcasts
127: ```
128: 
129: ### V3 Pool Deposit
130: 
131: ```
132: 1. defi search --token USDT --platform PancakeSwap --chain bsc --product-group DEX_POOL
133: 2. defi detail --investment-id <id>
134: 3. (Optional) defi depth-price-chart --investment-id <id>
135:    → show liquidity depth distribution to help user pick tick range
136: 4. Ask user for amount and tick range
137: 5. Check wallet balance (okx-agentic-wallet) → if insufficient, warn user and stop
138: 6. defi invest --investment-id <id> --address <addr> --token USDT --amount 100000000 --range 5
139:    → CLI handles calculate-entry internally, returns calldata
140: 7. User signs and broadcasts
141: ```
142: 
143: ### View Chart Data
144: 
145: Use chart commands to analyze product trends before investing or to monitor existing positions.
146: 
147: **APY History** — check yield trend before depositing:
148: ```
149: defi rate-chart --investment-id <id> --time-range MONTH
150: ```
151: - Time ranges: `WEEK` (default), `MONTH`, `SEASON` (3 months), `YEAR`. `DAY` is V3 Pool only.
152: - Returns: `timestamp`, `rate` (APY), `bonusRate` (extra rewards), `limitValue` (1=peak, -1=trough).
153: 
154: **TVL History** — evaluate pool size stability:
155: ```
156: defi tvl-chart --investment-id <id> --time-range SEASON
157: ```
158: - Time ranges: same as rate-chart.
159: - Returns: `chartVos[]` with `timestamp`, `tvl` (USD), `limitValue`.
160: 
161: **V3 Depth Chart** — see liquidity concentration to pick optimal tick range:
162: ```
163: defi depth-price-chart --investment-id <id>
164: ```
165: - Returns: `tick`, `liquidity`, `liquidityNet`, `token0Price`, `token1Price` per tick.
166: - No `--time-range` parameter — DEPTH mode always returns current snapshot.
167: - Use this before V3 Pool deposit to identify where liquidity is concentrated and choose `tickLower`/`tickUpper` accordingly.
168: 
169: **V3 Price History** — see historical relative price between token0 and token1:
170: ```
171: defi depth-price-chart --investment-id <id> --chart-type PRICE --time-range WEEK
172: ```
173: - Chart types: `DEPTH` (default), `PRICE`.
174: - `--time-range` only applies to PRICE mode: `DAY` (default), `WEEK`.
175: - Returns: `token0Price`, `token1Price`, `timestamp` per data point.
176: 
177: ### Step 3: Sign & Broadcast Calldata
178: 
179: After `invest`/`withdraw`/`collect` returns `dataList`, execute each step via one of two paths:
180: 
181: **Path A (user-provided wallet)**: user signs externally → broadcast via gateway
182: ```bash
183: # For each dataList step:
184: # 1. User signs the tx externally using dataList[N].to, dataList[N].serializedData, dataList[N].value
185: # 2. Broadcast:
186: onchainos gateway broadcast --signed-tx <signed_hex> --address <addr> --chain <chain>
187: # 3. Poll until confirmed:
188: onchainos gateway orders --address <addr> --chain <chain> --order-id <orderId>
189: # → wait for txStatus=2, then proceed to next step
190: ```
191: 
192: **Path B (Agentic Wallet)**: sign & broadcast via `wallet contract-call`
193: 
194: EVM chains (Ethereum, BSC, Polygon, Arbitrum, Base, etc.):
195: ```bash
196: onchainos wallet contract-call \
197:   --to <dataList[N].to> \
198:   --chain <chainIndex> \
199:   --input-data <dataList[N].serializedData> \
200:   --value <value_in_UI_units> \
201:   --biz-type defi
202: ```
203: 
204: EVM (XLayer):
205: ```bash
206: onchainos wallet contract-call \
207:   --to <dataList[N].to> \
208:   --chain 196 \
209:   --input-data <dataList[N].serializedData> \
210:   --value <value_in_UI_units> \
211:   --biz-type defi
212: ```
213: 
214: Solana:
215: ```bash
216: onchainos wallet contract-call \
217:   --to <dataList[N].to> \
218:   --chain 501 \
219:   --unsigned-tx <dataList[N].serializedData> \
220:   --biz-type defi
221: ```
222: 
223: `contract-call` handles TEE signing and broadcasting internally — no separate broadcast step needed.
224: 
225: **`--value` unit conversion**: `dataList[].value` is in minimal units (wei). `contract-call --value` expects UI units. Convert: `value_UI = value / 10^nativeToken.decimal` (e.g. 18 for ETH/POL, 9 for SOL). If `value` is `""`, `"0"`, or `"0x0"`, use `"0"`.
226: 
227: **`--chain` mapping**: `contract-call` and `gateway broadcast` require `realChainIndex` (e.g. `1`=Ethereum, `137`=Polygon, `56`=BSC, `501`=Solana, `196`=XLayer).
228: 
229: **Execution rules**:
230: - Execute `dataList[0]` first, then `dataList[1]`, etc. Never in parallel.
231: - Wait for on-chain confirmation before next step (Path A: `txStatus=2`; Path B: `contract-call` returns txHash).
232: - If any step fails, stop all remaining steps and report which succeeded/failed.
233: 
234: > `invest`/`withdraw`/`collect` only return **unsigned calldata** — they do NOT broadcast. The CLI never holds private keys.
235: 
236: ## Displaying Search / List Results
237: 
238: | # | Platform | Chain | investmentId | Name | APY | TVL |
239: |---|---------|-------|-------------|------|-----|-----|
240: | 1 | Aave V3 | ETH | 9502 | USDC | 1.89% | $3.52B |
241: 
242: - `investmentId` is **MANDATORY** in every row
243: - `rate` is decimal → multiply by 100 and append `%`
244: - `tvl` → format as human-readable USD ($3.52B, $537M)
245: - Display data as-is — do NOT editorialize on APY values
246: 
247: ## rewardType Reference
248: 
249: | rewardType | When to use | Required params |
250: |------------|-------------|-----------------|
251: | `REWARD_PLATFORM` | Protocol-level rewards (e.g. AAVE token) | `--platform-id` |
252: | `REWARD_INVESTMENT` | Product mining/staking rewards | `--investment-id` + `--platform-id` |
253: | `V3_FEE` | V3 trading fee collection | `--investment-id` + `--token-id` |
254: | `REWARD_OKX_BONUS` | OKX bonus rewards | `--investment-id` + `--platform-id` |
255: | `REWARD_MERKLE_BONUS` | Merkle proof-based bonus | `--investment-id` + `--platform-id` |
256: | `UNLOCKED_PRINCIPAL` | Unlocked principal after lock | `--investment-id` + `--principal-index` |
257: 
258: ## Key Protocol Rules
259: 
260: - **Aave borrow**: uses `callDataType=WITHDRAW` internally — do not expose to user
261: - **Aave repay**: uses `callDataType=DEPOSIT` internally — do not expose to user
262: - **V3 Pool exit**: pass `--token-id` + `--ratio` (e.g. `--ratio 1` for full exit)
263: - **Partial withdrawal (non-V3)**: pass `--amount` for the exit amount
264: - **Full withdrawal**: `--ratio 1`
265: 
266: ## Post-execution Suggestions
267: 
268: | Just completed | Suggest |
269: |----------------|---------|
270: | `defi list` / `defi search` | View details → `defi detail`, or start deposit flow |
271: | `defi detail` | Check trends → `defi rate-chart` / `defi tvl-chart`, or proceed → `defi invest` |
272: | `defi detail` (V3 Pool) | View depth → `defi depth-price-chart`, check price history → `defi depth-price-chart --chart-type PRICE` |
273: | `defi invest` success | View positions → `okx-defi-portfolio`, or search more |
274: | `defi withdraw` success | Check positions → `okx-defi-portfolio`, or check balance → `okx-agentic-wallet` |
275: | `defi collect` success | Check positions → `okx-defi-portfolio`, or swap rewards → `okx-agentic-wallet` |
276: 
277: ## Error Codes
278: 
279: | Code | Scenario | Handling |
280: |------|----------|----------|
281: | 84400 | Parameter null | Check required params — partial exit needs `--amount` or `--ratio` |
282: | 84021 | Asset syncing | "Position data is syncing, please retry shortly" |
283: | 84023 | Invalid expectOutputList | CLI auto-constructs from position-detail; retry or pass `--platform-id` |
284: | 84014 | Balance check failed | Insufficient balance — check with `okx-agentic-wallet` |
285: | 84018 | Balancing failed | V3 balancing failed — adjust price range or increase slippage |
286: | 84010 | Token not supported | Check supported tokens via `defi detail` |
287: | 84001 | Platform not supported | DeFi platform not supported |
288: | 84016 | Contract execution failed | Check parameters and retry |
289: | 84019 | Address format mismatch | Address format invalid for this chain |
290: | 50011 | Rate limit | Wait and retry |
291: 
292: ## Global Notes
293: 
294: - `--amount` must be in **minimal units** (integer). Convert: userAmount × 10^tokenPrecision. Example: 0.1 USDC (precision=6) → `--amount 100000`. Get tokenPrecision from `defi detail` or `defi position-detail`
295: - The wallet address parameter for ALL defi commands is `--address`
296: - `--slippage` default is `"0.01"` (1%); suggest `"0.03"`–`"0.05"` for volatile V3 pools
297: - **CRITICAL — Solana transaction expiry**: Solana DeFi transactions use base58-encoded VersionedTransaction with a blockhash that expires in ~60 seconds. After receiving calldata, you MUST warn the user: "This Solana transaction must be signed and broadcast within 60 seconds or it will expire. Please sign immediately." Do NOT proceed to other conversation without delivering this warning first.
298: - **CRITICAL — High APY risk warning**: When displaying search/list results, if any product has APY > 50% (rate > 0.5), you MUST warn the user: "WARNING: This product shows APY above 50%, which indicates elevated risk (potential impermanent loss, smart contract risk, or unsustainable rewards). Proceed with caution." Do NOT silently display high-APY products without this warning.
299: - **CRITICAL — Address-chain compatibility**: When calling `defi positions` or `defi position-detail`, the `--address` and chain parameters must be compatible. EVM addresses (`0x…`) can only query EVM chains; Solana addresses (base58) can only query `solana`. Never mix them — the API will return error 84019 (Address format error).
300:   - `0x…` address → only pass EVM chains: `ethereum,bsc,polygon,arbitrum,base,xlayer,avalanche,optimism,fantom,linea,scroll,zksync`
301:   - base58 address → only pass `solana`
302:   - If the user wants positions across both EVM and Solana, make **two separate calls** with the respective addresses
303: - User confirmation required before every invest/withdraw/collect execution

84: ## 4. onchainos defi search
85: 
86: Search DeFi products across chains (earn, pools, lending).
87: 
88: ```bash
89: onchainos defi search --token <tokens> [--platform <names>] [--chain <chain>] [--product-group <group>] [--page-num <n>]
